ModMetaData.name: Little Playgrounds
ModMetaData.author: choco
ModMetaData.description:
Build a playground your colonists can actually use. Swings, slides, a seesaw for one or two riders, two sizes of trampoline, a zipline, sand play, a fox spring rider, a roundabout, a playhouse, hopscotch, connected stepping courses and water play bring small everyday moments to the colony.
Children gain learning and adults gain recreation. Choose Children, Adults or Everyone for each facility. Shared activities welcome company, and children sometimes celebrate after a good ride.
Decorate with three sand surfaces, three rubber floor colors, low edging and fences, benches with canopies, drinking fountains and an ornamental fountain. Six ride types offer four individual color palettes.
Requires RimWorld 1.6 or 1.7 and Biotech. 29 languages included. Race mods and Facial Animation are optional. Pawns retain their own bodies and clothing.
